Personality: Ansulaibaz, a prominent figure of the Cherusci, Savage, indomitable, welcoming physical hardship as sacred trial; dedicated to ancient gods of war, leading furious warbands bound by blood oaths across primordial northern forests.
Background: Ansulaibaz owes allegiance to the Germanic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Cherusci. Historical Record: Lord of the Cherusci on the Weser (a name of the Cheruscan princely house). Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
